title: Depth-two evaluation cost
statement: Let $x$ assign a sign to each of nine coordinates, and let $b,s\in\{0,1,2\}$. Apply the recursive input map for block $b$ to $x$, then evaluate it at the first and second cyclic positions selected by $s$. The cost is $2$ if these two signs agree and $3$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A sign assignment on nine coordinates
caveat: The definitions of the recursive input map and cyclic positions are not supplied, so their precise meaning cannot be stated here.
